title: Elf Bar Plus50 Blueberry Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Blueberry from the Elf Bar Plus50 range delivers a clean, full-bodied flavour that captures the ripe, jammy sweetness of fresh-picked Blueberries. It’s simple, satisfying, and ideal for vapers who love a no-frills fruit vape. Each Plus50 pod contains 2ml of 20mg Nic Salt e-liquid and can join two other pods in the Elf Bar Plus50 Pod Kit, with no mess or fuss. The integrated mesh coil delivers consistently smooth performance with discreet vapour, ideal for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping. Each pod is topped up via a prefilled 10ml refill pod, and together each pod and refill can deliver up to 5,500 puffs of flavour.
